title: Grand Slam of Darts: Tuesday session
why: Final group games for Groups I to P; Luke Humphries, Michael van Gerwen and Nathan Aspinall won their groups.

title: Grand Slam of Darts: Wednesday session
why: Round two begins: Cross v Springer, Price v Searle, Littler v Wattimena and Doets v Menzies.

title: Grand Slam of Darts: Thursday session
why: Round two concludes: Clemens v Aspinall, van Veen v Schindler, Humphries v Sykes and Wade v van Gerwen.

title: Grand Slam of Darts: Friday quarter-finals
Grand Slam of Darts: Saturday quarter-finals
Grand Slam of Darts: semi-finals
why: Both semi-finals, starting at 8:00 AM New York time.

title: Grand Slam of Darts: final
why: The Grand Slam final, starting at 2:30 PM New York time.

title: Grand Slam of Curling: The National begins
why: Sixteen men's and sixteen women's teams at Centre 200 in Sydney, Nova Scotia, from 17 to 22 November. Draw times not confirmed.
